title: 菊花賞の後に・フクキタル、開☆眼

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru gives it her all on the chrysanthemum stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the strenuous undertaking, she states joyfully that the gods have made her the incarnation of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Concerned by the crazed glint in her eye, I leave most of her schedule open until the Kinko Sho next spring.
